data.exact_reserve_text: Within the calendar year net technical result, deficit of GBP 2.2m on direct business (2020: surplus of GBP 1.0m) and deficit of GBP 42.6m on reinsurance accepted business (2020: surplus of GBP 2.5m) relate to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years. The GBP 42.6m deficit is primarily due to material uncertainty arising from a potential accumulation of claims in respect of a single policyholder.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1110 experienced a net strengthening of GBP 44.8 million in prior year reserves. This adverse development is primarily attributed to a deficit of GBP 42.6 million on reinsurance accepted business and GBP 2.2 million on direct business, stemming from the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years. The main cause is material uncertainty arising from a potential accumulation of claims in respect of a single policyholder, with complex issues regarding coverage, liability, and quantum. The affected lines of business are primarily Casualty (inferred from reinsurance context) and other direct business.

deficit of GBP 42.6m on reinsurance accepted business
reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years
material uncertainty arising from a potential accumulation of claims in respect of a single policyholder
claims in question are very complex, due to uncertainty over coverage, liability and the quantum of the claims
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is reported net of reinsurance, as no gross figure was explicitly stated or reliably derivable due to distortions from ADC and LPT reinsurance transactions affecting the gross claims development triangle. Gross premium mix includes a negative value for 'Reinsurance' as reported in the 'Particulars of business written' note.
